{
  \pgfutil@tempdima=.28pt

{

\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}[
  node distance=13mm and 18mm,
  stage/.style={draw,rounded corners=2pt,minimum width=24mm,minimum height=8mm,align=center}
]
  \node[stage,fill=blue!8] (draft) {Draft};
  \node[stage,fill=yellow!16,right=of draft] (review) {Review};
  \node[stage,fill=green!10,right=of review] (publish) {Publish};
  \node[stage,fill=red!8,below=of review] (revise) {Revise};

  \draw[blue,line width=.4pt,-{adaptive process}] (draft) -- node[above]{submit} (review);
  \draw[green!50!black,line width=1pt,-{adaptive process}] (review) -- node[above]{approve} (publish);
  \draw[red,line width=1.6pt,-{adaptive process}] (review) -- node[right]{changes} (revise);
\end{tikzpicture}
